metaTitle: Mono vs Poly Solar Panels for Camping
description: Compare monocrystalline and polycrystalline solar panels on efficiency, size, heat tolerance and price to pick the right portable panel for camping.
directAnswer: Choose monocrystalline for camping: it is more efficient (about 18 to 23 percent versus 15 to 17), so panels are smaller and lighter for the same watts. Polycrystalline is cheaper but rare in folding panels.
